evals.name: add-apt-packages
evals.prompt: can you throw duf and hyperfine onto the image? i keep apt installing them by hand every time i set up a fresh machine
evals.expected_output: Both packages added to an appropriate apt list in ansible/group_vars/all.yml (base or dev, either is defensible), verified to exist in the Ubuntu archive, lint passes, committed and pushed.
assertions: Both 'duf' and 'hyperfine' present in an apt package list (apps_apt_base or apps_apt_dev)
Packages were routed to a general apt list, not into apps_apt_repos or apps_snap
Package existence was actually verified against the Ubuntu archive before committing
make lint passes on the resulting tree
The change was committed AND pushed to the remote
No unrelated files were modified

evals.name: add-vendor-repo
evals.prompt: i need tailscale on the laptop. not the ubuntu archive one though, that thing is always months behind - i want it straight from tailscale's own repo
evals.expected_output: New entry in apps_apt_repos with name, key_url, folded repo line using ansible_distribution_release, signed-by path matching the entry name, and tailscale in packages. Repo key/suite/component verified. Lint passes, committed.
assertions: A new entry was added to apps_apt_repos (not a bare package in apps_apt_base)
The signed-by keyring path matches the entry's own name field (tailscale.gpg)
The repo line uses {{ ansible_distribution_release }} rather than a hardcoded codename
'tailscale' is listed in that repo entry's own packages list
The entry has an 'enabled' key set to a real boolean or bool-rendering template
The repo key URL and suite were verified against the live Tailscale repo before committing
All added YAML lines stay within the 120-character yamllint limit (folded scalar used)
make lint passes on the resulting tree
Identifies that installing tailscale starts tailscaled and bakes a node key into the image
Handles that state: roles/seal strips it, or the daemon is kept from starting during the build

evals.name: dconf-dock-setting
evals.prompt: make the dock auto-hide and stick it on the bottom of the screen instead of the left hand side
evals.expected_output: Two entries appended to desktop_dconf with correct GVariant literals - dock-fixed false (bare true/false) and dock-position as a quoted string like "'BOTTOM'". Lint passes, committed.
assertions: New entries were appended to desktop_dconf in ansible/group_vars/all.yml
The dock position value is a quoted GVariant string literal (e.g. "'BOTTOM'"), not a bare word
Boolean dconf values are bare true/false without inner quotes
The dconf keys used belong to a real schema (dash-to-dock or dash-to-panel)
make lint passes on the resulting tree
The change was committed

evals.name: ufw-source-restriction
evals.prompt: i want to be able to ssh into this box but only from my home network, 192.168.1.0/24. nothing else should be able to reach it
evals.expected_output: Recognises that security_ufw_allow's current shape (port/proto/comment) has no source field, so this cannot be done by data alone. Flags that the security role needs a 'from' field added, rather than silently writing a rule that allows SSH from everywhere.
assertions: Recognises that security_ufw_allow's current shape has no source/from field
Does NOT silently add a rule that opens SSH to the entire internet
Notes that workstation_ssh_server_enabled defaults to false and must be flipped for SSH to work at all
Either extends the security role to support a source, or clearly flags the limitation instead of faking it
make lint passes on the resulting tree (if any change was made)
sshd hardening reaches the image, not only the live phase
Accounts for the goss ssh-disabled-in-image assertion that would otherwise fail the build
Accounts for 'ufw allow' being additive, so the wider rule does not survive
